# A S Nandanunni

Software Engineer based in Bangalore, India. 3+ years of professional
experience at FenixPyre (zero-trust file security: encryption, secure
collaboration, sensitive-data discovery), currently as Frontend Lead
& Backend Engineer.

## Professional Experience
- FenixPyre (Mar 2023-present): Frontend Lead & Backend Engineer. Built
  a SIEM event collection platform across 9+ services, an automated
  Egnyte token lifecycle management system, and the cloud dashboard and
  post-processor for an on-device (Rust/ONNX) sensitive-file classifier.
- Cura (Dec 2025-Apr 2026, freelance): built an AI front-desk platform's
  unified messaging inbox, RAG-grounded AI agent, and a React Flow-based
  AI workflow builder.
- Revyu (2020-2023): first engineer, then co-founder, of a Shopify
  review-management app.

## Independent Projects
- Yigloo (https://yigloo.app): solo-built platform, 8 services across
  TypeScript, Python, and Go, shared identity/SSO and multi-tenant
  Postgres database.
- Void Design: open-source React component library (npm).
- Void Proton: open-source Python backend framework (PyPI).

## Education
- M.Tech, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, IIIT Kottayam
  (2024-2027, in progress)
- B.Tech, Computer Science Engineering, CUSAT (2019-2023)
